title: Carry stack fix: delayed diagnostic retirement after a second carry must not let older carries borrow or credit the first run
outcome: Carry stack fix: delayed diagnostic retirement after a second carry must not let older carries borrow or credit the first run
acceptance: When a diagnostic retirement is applied after a second carry exists, every existing carry inherits the new ambiguous window, so no carry can borrow or be credited from the first run; a RED-first regression test reproduces the review scenario on tree 590ddac3 and passes after the fix.

The fix is delivered as a patch onto Merger's carry tree 590ddac3; focused carried_checks tests pass on the patched input, and a fresh read-only Codex+Claude pair on the fix hunks has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.
